reader.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept. Create the FINAL COHESIVE ILLUSTRATED BACKGROUND asset for an interactive reading room website, landscape 16:9 at high resolution.
Input image 1 is the approved open book and floral page decoration reference. Use its bookbinding, restrained old rose palette, subtle ink-and-watercolor flowers, olive leaves, lily-of-the-valley floral margins, delicate paper grain. Repaint an entire single coherent scene in one rendering, NOT a cutout or collage.
Scene: overhead, straight-on, a paper-theatre artist's beautiful reading desk. The whole desktop is softly lit dusty lilac / old rose matte hand-tinted paper with delicate almost imperceptible damask texture. The large open antique storybook is aligned horizontally, centered, occupying roughly x=12% to88%, y=7% to91%. Both pages are equal, upright rectangular reading areas, with a gentle central gutter and very shallow bound-page relief. Rose book cover, restrained worn corners, small bookmark tip at bottom. Fine floral ornaments stay in the OUTER page margins and bottom corners, leave the central 76% of each page completely blank pale blush parchment for real live text. The pages MUST BE BLANK: no Chinese, no letters, no page numbers, no decorative cluster across their central reading areas.
Five modest functional objects rest naturally on the surrounding desk, all created at the SAME TIME in this SAME IMAGE under the SAME soft light, with appropriate small attached contact shadows and paper texture:
1. Upper left desk beside the book, a small folded three-panel paper theatre programme in faded rose, around x=6%, y=24%, a tiny engraved decorative rule but no text.
2. Mid-left beside book, a small stack of library catalogue cards in a slim rose paper sleeve, around x=6%, y=57%, with a fine cotton string loosely around them. No book or book cover.
3. Upper right desk, around x=94%, y=22%, a small old brass key lying at a slight diagonal, a faded lilac cord naturally resting in a loose loop on the desk.
4. Lower left desk, around x=6%, y=85%, one little wooden spool wound with dusty rose thread, a fine loose thread trailing naturally along desk.
5. Lower right desk, around x=94%, y=85%, a second little wooden thread spool, coherent with left one, slight opposite tilt and trailing thread.
These objects are part of the illustrated scene, lying on its surface with natural material shadows. No isolated sprites, no uniform sticker outlines, no rectangular patches, no floating icons. They are small and quiet; the open book is the star.
Style: refined hand-painted watercolor / colored-pencil / antique book illustration with matte paper grain, low saturation old rose, subtle lilac, muted olive leaves; fine irregular artist-drawn linework, softly dimensional papercraft rather than glossy 3D. Consistent painterly density across background, book and props. No sepia yellow cast. No black tabletop, no dark vignette, no bright saturated pink, no neon, no glow, no interface bars, no logos, no words, no arrows. Preserve realistic physically joined book geometry and natural flower anatomy. Flat lay neatly framed for a working two-page reader, full scene all at once.

library.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept. Generate one coherent landscape 16:9 illustrated background for the LIBRARY companion page of the reading room shown in reference image 1. SAME old rose / lilac hand-tinted paper, subtle damask, refined watercolor and colored pencil, soft unified light. Reference is for palette/materials only: do NOT include the open book.
We will place the actual original book covers in HTML afterward, so every shelf is EMPTY. A frontal shallow paper-theatre cabinet / book display wall fills the middle 77% width. Three restrained thin horizontal shelves made of folded dusty lilac cardstock span x=12% to88%, their upper resting edges at approximately y=34%, 61%, 88%. Shelf relief extremely shallow, not chunky 3D or perspective furniture. Three large clean empty rows behind them with quiet soft rose matte paper. Delicate hand-drawn fine foliage in outer corner margins, no plant stems crossing the cover area. Cabinet vertical outer edges lightly layered, soft integrated contact shadows.
The upper margin center has a quiet small pale blush paper title tab left blank.
Two functional little objects are painted as part of this COMPLETE SAME SCENE, with matching contact shadows and naturally resting cords:
At upper right outside shelves x=94%, y=18%, an antique brass key with loose old lilac cord resting naturally against the paper display.
At lower right x=94%, y=78%, a small stack of catalogue index cards and a slim brass magnifying glass, naturally together on the shallow desk margin.
Keep these objects small and harmonious, all drawn together with environment, NOT separate icon stickers, NOT sprites or collage. No text anywhere, no invented book covers, no books, no numbers, no labels, no arrows. Refined minimal book display with generous empty shelf spaces for twelve real front-facing covers, matching the illustrated rose reading desk exactly. No black, no harsh contrast, no dark vignette, no excessive flowers, no shiny realistic 3D. Every shelf and decorative prop belongs to one consistent painterly scene.

rendering: Each full scene generated in one pass; no independent prop assets. Runtime motion samples each single scene texture.
